Application Data.NAME: Acme Building Supplies, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Building Supplies, Inc. specializes in the wholesale distribution of a wide range of building materials and supplies, including lumber, drywall, insulation, roofing materials, and plumbing fixtures. We serve contractors, construction companies, and retail outlets, providing them with quality products at competitive prices. Our operations include warehousing, inventory management, and transportation logistics to ensure timely delivery to our clients. We prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant building codes and regulations, and we are committed to maintaining high standards in customer service and product quality.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a delivery truck carrying drywall was involved in an accident resulting in $15,000 in damages; currently under investigation. On August 10, 2023, a warehouse fire caused by electrical issues led to $10,000 in damages; claim settled. Total losses amount to $25,000.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 1, Grade A, Fire Resistance Rated, certified by Underwriters Laboratories (UL)
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing with barbed wire, monitored by security cameras and patrolled by on-site security personnel during operational hours.
